info.title: Territorio Paysandú implemented HTTP API
info.description: Local G1/G2 implementation contract, not a released v1.0 claim. Authentication uses Supabase SSR cookies whose names/chunks depend on project configuration. No bearer-token input is implemented by these browser-facing handlers. Configure cookie security and native Auth abuse limits before release. Same-origin mutation protection; no cross-origin API access. Standard unsupported methods return405 with Allow; unknown route404. Every handled response includes safe request ID and no-store. Logs omit URL parameters, bodies, identity, IP and credentials. Operational timezone filters are explicitly UTC pending institutional policy.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC calendar day; implemented as strictly before next UTC midnight, preserving database submillisecond precision. Must be on or after from.
